snapshots.title: H4essential 4-Track Handy Recorder
snapshots.description: The Zoom H4essential is a versatile 4-track portable audio recorder designed for musicians, filmmakers, and podcasters. It features 32-bit float recording for distortion-free audio without manual level adjustments, and dual XLR-1/4" combo inputs with phantom power. The built-in X/Y microphones can handle up to 130 dB SPL. The recorder also functions as a 4-in/2-out USB-C audio interface. It includes accessibility features like audible menu navigation and a 2" color display, plus tripod-mount capability and long battery life. This bundle includes the recorder, a Zoom ZDM-1 Podcast Mic Pack, AA batteries with a charger, a 64GB memory card, an XLR cable, a cleaning kit, wire ties, a power bank battery, a USB card reader, and a USB-C cable.

snapshots.title: Zoom H4essential 4-Track 32-Bit Float Portable Audio Recorder
snapshots.description: The Zoom H4essential is a portable 4-track handheld audio recorder designed for musicians, content creators, and podcasters. It features 32-bit float recording, which eliminates the need for level adjustments to prevent clipping. The device is equipped with built-in X/Y stereo microphones capable of handling up to 130 dB SPL and two XLR-1/4" TRS combo inputs with low-noise preamps and +48V phantom power. It includes a 2" color LCD screen with real-time waveform display and can function as a 4-in / 2-out USB-C audio interface for computers and smart devices. The recorder is tripod mountable and supports microSDXC cards up to 1TB.

snapshots.title: Shure SM58 Dynamic Microphone
snapshots.description: The Shure SM58 is a legendary dynamic vocal microphone designed for professional use in live performances, sound reinforcement, and studio recording. It features a tailored frequency response for vocals with a brightened midrange and bass rolloff, and a cardioid pickup pattern that isolates the main sound source while minimizing background noise. Built for durability, it includes a pneumatic shock-mount system to reduce handling noise and a spherical mesh grille with a built-in pop filter to minimize wind and breath noise.

snapshots.title: Cardioid Dynamic Vocal Microphone
snapshots.description: This Shure SM58-LC is a professional dynamic vocal microphone renowned for its durability and exceptional sound quality. It features a cardioid polar pattern, which effectively isolates the main sound source and minimizes unwanted background noise. The microphone has a tailored vocal response for clear reproduction and includes a built-in spherical wind and pop filter to reduce breath and plosive noises. Its rugged construction and proven shock-mount system ensure consistent performance even with rough handling, making it a world standard for live performance and studio recording.

snapshots.title: Shure SM58 Microphone Kit
snapshots.description: This bundle includes the world-renowned Shure SM58 dynamic vocal microphone, known for its professional quality and durability. The cardioid pickup pattern isolates the main sound source, reducing background noise. The bundle also comes with a 20-foot Gear One XLR cable for reliable signal transmission and a Musician's Gear MS-220 tripod microphone stand with a fixed boom, offering adjustable height for optimal positioning. snapshots.title: SM58-CN Handheld Cardioid Dynamic Vocal Microphone with 25-Foot XLR Cable
snapshots.description: The Shure SM58-CN is a professional handheld cardioid dynamic vocal microphone designed for clear vocal pickup. It features a uniform cardioid pickup pattern to isolate the main sound source and minimize background noise, making it ideal for live performances. snapshots.title: SM58-S Cardioid Dynamic Handheld Wired Microphone

snapshots.title: Shure BLX24 Wireless Vocal System
snapshots.description: The Shure BLX24/SM58 is a professional wireless vocal system featuring the legendary SM58 microphone capsule. It offers up to 14 hours of continuous operation on a single pair of AA batteries and supports up to 12 channels per frequency band, making it ideal for singers and performers who need freedom of movement without sacrificing audio quality.

snapshots.description: This is a used Shure PGA48 dynamic microphone in good condition. snapshots.title: AT2020 Large-Diaphragm Condenser Microphone
snapshots.description: The Audio-Technica AT2020 is a professional-level large-diaphragm condenser microphone designed for home and project studios. It features a custom-engineered 16mm diaphragm providing an extended frequency response from 20 Hz to 20 kHz, ensuring clear and natural reproduction of vocals and acoustic instruments. Its cardioid polar pattern focuses on the sound source in front of the mic while minimizing background noise from the sides and rear. With a high 144dB SPL handling and wide dynamic range, it can record everything from subtle whispers to loud guitar amplifiers without distortion. Its low self-noise makes it ideal for use with high-quality digital recording equipment for a clean, professional signal path.

snapshots.title: AT2020 Cardioid Condenser Microphone
snapshots.description: This is a versatile, side-address cardioid condenser microphone designed for home recording and project studio applications. It offers studio-quality articulation and intelligibility, making it ideal for musicians, streamers, podcasters, and other content creators. The microphone features a custom-engineered 0.6" low-mass diaphragm, extended frequency response, and superior transient response. Its cardioid polar pattern effectively reduces pickup of sounds from the sides and rear, improving isolation of the desired sound source and minimizing background noise. The AT2020 boasts high SPL handling and a wide dynamic range for versatility, allowing it to capture loud signals with minimal noise and distortion. It operates on 48V DC phantom power and has a balanced XLR 3-pin output connector. The microphone comes with a stand mount, an adapter for different threaded stands, and a protective pouch, all housed in a rugged construction for reliable performance.
